error.invalid_cookies: Luminus rejected the cookies (expired, logged out or blocked). Copy fresh cookies from your browser.

user.title: My Luminus - Add device
user.description: Log in at https://www.luminus.be/myluminus/nl/ in your browser. Open the developer tools (F12), Network tab, reload the page, select the first www.luminus.be request and copy the value of the 'cookie' request header. The session is renewed automatically; you only need to paste new cookies if Home Assistant asks you to reauthenticate.
